content.short: Gate provides well-known centralized cryptocurrency exchange for international traders.
content.description: Gate is an altcoin trading platform where users can trade, sell, or buy a wide range of digital assets (around 180 coins) across nearly 400 cryptocurrency markets. The platform also provides access to additional offerings such as strategy bots to help automate trading decisions. For developers, Gate exposes an API and SDK that enable programmatic access to information and functionality for spot trading, margin trading, and contract trading, supporting integration with external tools and applications.
